title: Doctor Finds Nurse Murdered After Missing Hospital Shift
description:
Bodycam footage shows Dublin, Georgia police responding after coworkers discovered nurse Tiffany Scarborough shot dead inside her home. Her husband, Benjamin Whitaker, was missing from the scene. Officers tracked Whitaker down and he admitted to shooting Tiffany during a drunken argument just 59 days after their wedding.
